items.summary: Recommendation: approve only three normal-priority, metadata-only task-routing repairs for 0daynews.com, amputeenews.com, and eastcoastrappers.com. Reject the weirdgirlstore.com readiness baseline because the supplied evidence does not expose site-specific outcomes and the report lacks a measurable production or financial decision. Preserve one bounded public inspection for weapontester.com to close the observable positioning and conversion-path evidence gap. Do not authorize unsupported revenue or causal claims, duplicate telemetry, production changes, credential or configuration changes, spending, schedule changes, or high-priority queue work.
